turns.text: But first, let me work up the energy to ask you a question, Neil.
turns.zh: 不过首先，让我攒攒劲儿来问你一个问题，尼尔。

turns.text: Of course, some animals have a reputation for lounging about lions, for example, can sleep up to twenty hours a day!
turns.zh: 当然啦，有些动物出了名的爱懒着——比如说狮子，一天能睡上二十个小时呢！

turns.text: But what is the slowest moving animal on Earth?
turns.zh: 但地球上移动最慢的动物是什么呢？

turns.text: Is it: a) the giant tortoise b) the three-toed sloth or c) the koala?
turns.zh: 是：a) 巨型陆龟 b) 三趾树懒 还是 c) 考拉？

turns.text: Well, I think it’s the three-toed sloth.
I’ll reveal the correct answer at the end of the programme.
turns.zh: 我会在节目最后揭晓正确答案。

turns.text: Now it’s no surprise that lazy lions love relaxing, but even animals with reputations for being busy spend time doing nothing.
turns.zh: 现在，懒狮子爱放松这毫不奇怪，但就连那些出了名忙碌的动物也会花时间什么都不做。
